title: Robot Arm
statementMd:
Roger is a robot. He has an arm that is a series of $*n*$ segments connected to each other. The endpoints of the $*i*$-th segment are initially located at points $(*i* - 1, 0)$ and $(*i*, 0)$. The endpoint at $(*i* - 1, 0)$ is colored red and the endpoint at $(*i*, 0)$ is colored blue for all segments. Thus, the blue endpoint of the $*i*$-th segment is touching the red endpoint of the $(*i* + 1)$-th segment for all valid $*i*$.

Roger can move his arm in two different ways:

1. He can choose some segment and some value. This is denoted as choosing the segment number $*i*$ and picking some positive $*l*$. This change happens as follows: the red endpoint of segment number $*i*$ and segments from $1$ to $*i* - 1$ are all fixed in place. Imagine a ray from the red endpoint to the blue endpoint. The blue endpoint and segments $*i* + 1$ through $*n*$ are translated $*l*$ units in the direction of this ray. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/494cc2c6bc66ee9b700ef86a99daba68618cd5b7.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/40d4cee4ae3e2a2de7bf864f95689db46dd63a74.png) In this picture, the red point labeled $*A*$ and segments before $*A*$ stay in place, while the blue point labeled $*B*$ and segments after $*B*$ gets translated.
2. He can choose a segment and rotate it. This is denoted as choosing the segment number $*i*$, and an angle $*a*$. The red endpoint of the $*i*$-th segment will stay fixed in place. The blue endpoint of that segment and segments $*i* + 1$ to $*n*$ will rotate clockwise by an angle of $*a*$ degrees around the red endpoint. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99858f5e450dc5d06ca1593230354f8bf6f1f037.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b659d1a90e2430db0dff4f295c564f810cd75ff0.png) In this picture, the red point labeled $*A*$ and segments before $*A*$ stay in place, while the blue point labeled $*B*$ and segments after $*B*$ get rotated around point $*A*$.

Roger will move his arm $*m*$ times. These transformations are a bit complicated, and Roger easily loses track of where the blue endpoint of the last segment is. Help him compute the coordinates of the blue endpoint of the last segment after applying each operation. Note that these operations are cumulative, and Roger's arm may intersect itself arbitrarily during the moves.

## Input

The first line of the input will contain two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 300 000$) — the number of segments and the number of operations to perform.

Each of the next $*m*$ lines contains three integers $*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$ and $*z*_{*i*}$ describing a move. If $*x*_{*i*} = 1$, this line describes a move of type $1$, where $*y*_{*i*}$ denotes the segment number and $*z*_{*i*}$ denotes the increase in the length. If $*x*_{*i*} = 2$, this describes a move of type 2, where $*y*_{*i*}$ denotes the segment number, and $*z*_{*i*}$ denotes the angle in degrees. ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 2, 1 ≤ *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *z*_{*i*} ≤ 359$)

## Output

Print $*m*$ lines. The $*i*$-th line should contain two real values, denoting the coordinates of the blue endpoint of the last segment after applying operations $1, ..., *i*$. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 4}$.

Namely, let's assume that your answer for a particular value of a coordinate is $*a*$ and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49eb236611e23b2e7c8e81e9516771daca716eec.png) for all coordinates.

## Note

The following pictures shows the state of the arm after each operation. The coordinates of point $*F*$ are printed after applying each operation. For simplicity, we only show the blue endpoints of a segment (with the exception for the red endpoint of the first segment). For instance, the point labeled $*B*$ is the blue endpoint for segment $1$ and also the red endpoint for segment $2$.

statementZhMd:
罗杰是一个机器人。他有一条由 $*n*$ 段首尾相连组成的机械臂。第 $*i*$ 段的两个端点初始位于点 $(*i* - 1, 0)$ 和 $(*i*, 0)$。对于所有线段，位于 $(*i* - 1, 0)$ 的端点被涂成红色，位于 $(*i*, 0)$ 的端点被涂成蓝色。因此，对于所有合法的 $*i*$，第 $*i*$ 段的蓝色端点与第 $(*i* + 1)$ 段的红色端点相接触。

罗杰可以通过以下两种方式移动他的机械臂：

1. 他可以选择某一段以及一个数值。具体来说，就是选择线段编号 $*i*$，并选择某个正数 $*l*$。变化过程如下：编号为 $*i*$ 的线段的红色端点，以及编号从 $1$ 到 $*i* - 1$ 的线段，均保持原位不动。以红色端点为起点、蓝色端点为终点作一条射线。蓝色端点以及编号为 $*i* + 1$ 到 $*n*$ 的线段，沿这条射线的方向平移 $*l*$ 个单位长度。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/494cc2c6bc66ee9b700ef86a99daba68618cd5b7.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/40d4cee4ae3e2a2de7bf864f95689db46dd63a74.png) 在这张图中，标记为 $*A*$ 的红点以及 $*A*$ 之前的线段保持不动，而标记为 $*B*$ 的蓝点以及 $*B*$ 之后的线段发生了平移。

2. 他可以选择某一段并旋转它。具体来说，就是选择线段编号 $*i*$，以及一个角度 $*a*$。第 $*i*$ 段的红色端点保持不动，该线段的蓝色端点以及编号从 $*i* + 1$ 到 $*n*$ 的线段，均绕红色端点顺时针旋转 $*a*$ 度。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99858f5e450dc5d06ca1593230354f8bf6f1f037.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b659d1a90e2430db0dff4f295c564f810cd75ff0.png) 在这张图中，标记为 $*A*$ 的红点以及 $*A*$ 之前的线段保持不动，而标记为 $*B*$ 的蓝点以及 $*B*$ 之后的线段绕点 $*A*$ 旋转。

罗杰将移动他的机械臂 $*m*$ 次。这些变换有些复杂，罗杰很容易弄不清最后一段的蓝色端点位于何处。请你在每次操作后计算最后一段的蓝色端点坐标。注意，这些操作是累积进行的，并且机械臂在移动过程中可以任意地与自身相交。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 300 000$），分别表示线段的数量和要执行的操作数量。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 $*x*_{*i}$、$*y*_{*i}$ 和 $*z*_{*i}$，描述一次移动。如果 $*x*_{*i*} = 1$，则该行描述一次类型 $1$ 的移动，其中 $*y*_{*i}$ 表示线段编号，$*z*_{*i}$ 表示增加的长度。如果 $*x*_{*i*} = 2$，则该行描述一次类型 $2$ 的移动，其中 $*y*_{*i}$ 表示线段编号，$*z*_{*i}$ 表示角度（单位为度）。（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i} ≤ 2, 1 ≤ *y*_{*i} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *z*_{*i} ≤ 359$）

## 输出格式

输出 $*m*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行应包含两个实数，表示执行操作 $1, ..., *i*$ 后最后一段的蓝色端点坐标。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 4}$，则会被判定为正确。

具体来说，假设对于某个坐标，你输出的答案为 $*a*$，标准答案为 $*b*$。对于所有坐标，如果 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49eb236611e23b2e7c8e81e9516771daca716eec.png)，则评测程序会认为你的答案正确。
